WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    eventannotm,
    AVG(instownpct) as group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as baseline_val
  FROM group_avgs
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT ga.group_avg
  FROM group_avgs ga
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ga.group_avg > b.baseline_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline_averages,
  AVG(group_avg - (SELECT baseline_val FROM baseline)) as mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM above_baseline
